text:
Erin: Hey folks — planning a small install of a ‘Core Values’ sticker mosaic in Lobby A next Friday (4/16). Need volunteers to prep stickers, apply to the wall, and handle light logistics. 3 shifts (2h each): 9:00–11:00, 11:00–13:00, 13:00–15:00. Sign up here: http://tiny.company/signups/sticker-mosaic :sparkles:

Mike: Quick q — will we need a ladder and specialty adhesive? don’t want stickers peeling in a month.

June: I can bring a 6ft step ladder and a roll of removable adhesive tape (museum-grade). happy to do prep night too (Wednesday 4/14 evening).

Sam: How many people per shift do you want? also curious about mask/gloves for applying.

Linda: I’ll handle layout — I’ll pre-cut the stickers into sheets and produce a grid template so installation is just matched-by-number. will bring a few squeegees and a marker for touchups.

Erin: Ideal is 6 people per shift (3 applicators + 3 support/trim/photodoc). masks optional but gloves recommended for sticky edges. We have a $200 craft budget; can we cover extra adhesives and a roll of transfer paper? @Mike can you confirm?

Mike: $200 covered. I’ll pick up transfer paper + painter’s tape tonight. also ordering two pairs of nitrile gloves.

ops-bot: Signup confirmed — Erin added June, Linda to 9:00–11:00; Mike to 11:00–13:00. (automated message)

June: I’m in for 9–11 and prep night. also can do a short how-to for volunteers on Wednesday — 30m demo.

Linda: Demo is great. I’ll create a 1-page cheat sheet with numbers + orientation. can we print it at 200% so alignment is clearer?

Sam: I’ll coordinate photography and a short comms blurb for announcements. can someone drop a sentence about timing and mask/glove recs? I’ll paste into #general after install.

Erin: Sample blurb: “Join us Friday 4/16 to help install a mosaic celebrating Redwood’s core values — shifts from 9–3. No experience needed; all supplies provided. Light snacks + photos after. Sign up: http://tiny.company/signups/sticker-mosaic”. edit as needed @Sam. :heart:

Mike: One operational note — we should block the immediate lobby corridor for the morning of the install (Facilities). I’ll send a quick calendar block and a sign to redirect visitors.

Erin: Perfect. Can volunteers arrive 10 minutes early for a quick safety/kit check? Also we’ll have a small waiver clipboard for photos.

Linda: Copy on the waiver? I can print 20 copies.

June: I’ll bring the basic first-aid kit and a roll of paper towels for small smudges.

Sam: Love it. I’ll bring a Polaroid for the mosaic reveal photo.

Erin: Amazing — thanks team. I’ll update the signup sheet, post the comms blurb on Thursday, and drop the prep-night agenda (Wed 7pm) in the calendar. See you all then! :tada:
